serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: This place is huge!
Big Daddy: Yes, it is quite impressive, but really, you need to visit my villa in da Alps some day. It’s a thing of beauty.
Big Daddy: If you ever wanted to visit me in this city though, just ask our concierge. I will give you a passcode for da front door so you can enter da lobby anytime.
You: Oh. Uh…{{wi}} Are you sure?
Big Daddy: Of course! I trust you man. You be like a small brother to me! 
He really seems like a nice guy. I can count on one hand the number of people who were nice to me as much as Big Daddy.
Big Daddy: Leonardo, that’s my friend right here. He might drop by sometimes so be nice to him.
Concierge Leonardo: Yes Sir. As always, I’m happy to help.
Big Daddy: Alright Anon, let’s take an elevator to my apartment.
You: Ok.
